bugClass: performance (ReDoS / catastrophic backtracking); secondary spec-ambiguous per-line trim behavior change
bugSummary: CVE-2023-26115: with options.trim the code ran result.replace(/\s+$/g, ''), whose /\s+$/ on a long whitespace run triggers catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS); the fix replaces it with a manual per-line trimTabAndSpaces. The replacement ALSO changes output value on multi-line text (per-line vs end-of-string trim), which is mildly spec-ambiguous against the README wording.
